room.description: A busy open-plan room, 6 × 5 m: a living area (a sofa facing a TV unit, two armchairs and a coffee table), two bookcases on the back wall, a dining table with four chairs under a linear pendant, and a kitchen island. Nine pieces block light; chairs don't, in Lux Studio, so they're in the picture only. Nine luminaires: seven downlights, the pendant (Finelite HP-2) and a wall washer (Lightolier) on the back wall beside the bookcases. Finishes from walnut (0.15) to white (0.8). Measures how accuracy and time scale with a full room.
